problem: A broad skill name activates on unrelated tasks; instructions grow and code changes unnoticed.
principle: Metadata supports discovery; the body contains the method; references, templates and deterministic helpers serve different purposes. Format validity, behavior quality and code execution require separate checks.
solutions: Do not manufacture empty resource folders
Resources must be discoverable and bounded
Integrity is not proof of safety
check: Are metadata.version and tool bindings mandatory Agent Skills fields?
answer: No. name and description are required. This example adds version/bindings as Host conventions; allowed-tools is experimental and implementation-dependent.
scope: Based on Agent Skills format; version pins, bundle digests and tool bindings are example Host conventions, not execution authority.
